fact: Alleged unnecessary impeding of Car 23 by Car 55 in turn 13. Infringment Alleged breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz), the driver of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, team radio and in-car video evidence. The weather conditions resulted in significant visibility problems for the drivers especially on the straight between Turns 12 and 13. The team had previously been warned by Race Control about a similar incident the prior lap at the same location and we noted that communications between the team and driver were satisfactory. The driver of Car 55 stated he knew of the approach of Car 23 but had to back off significantly because of the presence in front of him, of Car 1. The wording of Article 35.7 includes the words "unnecessarily impedes another driver". In this case both parties and the Stewards believe that this was not a case of unnecessarily impeding and that the driver of Car 55 acted in the manner he did in order to, in his view, avoid the car in front and the approaching car from behind. Both drivers raised with the Stewards the issue of cars backing up at Turn 13. They strongly suggested that it would be better, in the wet, for any backing up to occur at Turn 10 where they believe there was better visibility. Drivers are reminded of their responsibilities under Article 33.4 of the Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 55 Alleged Impeding Of Car 23
